  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Segment,
    SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'

  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment

  SELECT 
    Segment,

  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    c.CustomerID,
    c.total_consumption
  FROM cust_2013 c
  JOIN min_consumption_per_segment m 
    ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c.total_consumption = m.min_total_consumption
),
segment_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM lowest_customers
  GROUP BY Segment
)
